atten3.ptxt: When measuring the resistance of the CAN bus, turn the IG OFF, confirm that warning functions such as the key reminder warning system are not operating, and leave the vehicle for 1 minutes or more without operating the key or opening/closing the doors before starting measurement. If it is necessary to open a door during inspection, open it beforehand.

item.ptxt: Identify the connectors connected to CAN J/C4 by the wire color of the communication lines (bus) and the differences in the connector mating surfaces.

If CAN J/C4 is disconnected, connecting it to any position will not affect performance; however, considering the effect of tension on the wiring and subsequent serviceability, connect it to its original installation position.
If the destination of a connector is unknown, use the connected ECU check function of the SST (TaSCAN) to check which ECUs and sensors disappear from the display when the connector is disconnected.
